sections.heading: HONOURS SPECIALIZATION IN SOCIOLOGY
lines: Enrolment in this module is limited. Meeting the minimum requirements does not guarantee that students wishing to transfer into this module will be offered enrollment.

Completion of first-year requirements with no failures. Students must have an average of at least 70% in 3.0 principal courses, including Sociology 1020, Sociology 1020W/X or Sociology 1021E, plus 2.0 additional courses, with no mark in these principal courses below 60%.
3.0 courses: Sociology 2205A/B, Sociology 2206A/B, Sociology 3306A/B, Sociology 3310F/G, Sociology 3405F/G, Sociology 4446F/G.
1.0 course from: Sociology 2240E or Sociology 2270A/B plus Sociology 2271A/B.
2.5 additional courses in Sociology at the 2200 level or above.
1.5 additional courses in Sociology at the 3000 level or above.
0.5 additional course in Sociology at the 4000 level at King’s.

Please note that Sociology 2205A/B and Sociology 2206A/B are mandatory in year 2 of the Honours Specialization, and Sociology 3306A/B and Sociology 3310F/G are mandatory in year 3 of the Honours Specialization.
